high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "We Are All Sinners." The poster features a striking red background with a person's face prominently displayed in the center. The individual has curly hair and is wearing large hoop earrings. The lighting on the face is dramatic, with a reddish hue that gives it an intense and somewhat ominous appearance. The text at the top of the poster reads "JAYME LAWSON IS PEARLINE," indicating that Jayme Lawson plays the character Pearline in the film. Below the character's face, the title "WE ARE ALL SINNERS" is written in bold, white, distressed-style
